pairs.subject: plan-entitlements
pairs.evidence: crates/apps/homewyse-pricing/src/lib.rs:1 These crates scrape outside pricing, tax, licensing, valuation and labour-market data as datasets (here 'pricing' means scraped market prices, not this product's own price book). A case-insensitive grep over all eight app directories found 0 hits for entitlement, billing, plan_id or upgrade, and none of these crates has a tier model, capability gate or subscription lifecycle for this subject to govern.

techniques.evidence: crates/apps/homewyse-pricing/src/lib.rs:1 These crates sell no tiers. 'Pricing' is the domain of the data being scraped.
crates/apps/state-tax/src/lib.rs:109 The apps only implement ScrapeApp. None of them has a plan-inclusion gate.
crates/apps/homewyse-pricing/src/lib.rs:28 The only 'subscription' here is the operator's own Claude CLI subscription. This product has no customer subscription lifecycle.
